direction: New material-driven score following the original full structure: glass/harp motif and bowed vibraphone, marimba eighths, then sixteenths and a pulse, designed crossover/puck accents, and a warm closing harp chord. Each plate cue is generated from the exact physical landing schedule; every tenth brass ruler plate rings a D-pentatonic pitch. No original score audio reused.

sections.intent: Wind leads; sparse glass-harp/mallet and harp
Paired climb; marimba eighths and pulse
Sixteenths,52 metal landings and high glock line
Heavy puck, bell and settling ticks; harp ending
